**1 — Scene:** Pizza pieces alongside skin-on fish, lentils and leafy greens. Food on the neighbouring plates is excluded.

**2 — Vessel:** A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 27 cm across. Allowing for its square shape, I estimate an equivalent circular diameter of **28 cm**: area = 3.14 × 14² ≈ **615 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Tomato/onion/cheese pizza pieces at the top; cheese pizza pieces below; skin-on fish; cooked lentils; leafy greens; a little visible oily dressing. Pizza toppings are included in the pizza estimates.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:**

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Top pizza pieces, with tomato, onion and cheese | 16% | 98 cm² × 1.2 cm = 118 ml | 0.9 | 106 g | 250 | 265 kcal |
| Lower cheese pizza pieces | 14% | 86 cm² × 1.3 cm = 112 ml | 0.9 | 101 g | 280 | 283 kcal |
| Skin-on fish | 20% | 123 cm² × 1.25 cm = 154 ml | 0.95 | 146 g | 210 | 307 kcal |
| Cooked lentils | 10% | 62 cm² × 1.4 cm = 86 ml | 0.8 | 69 g | 116 | 80 kcal |
| Leafy greens | 5% | 31 cm² × 1.5 cm = 46 ml | 0.15 | 7 g | 20 | 1 kcal |
| Oily dressing | Overlay* | Approximately 4 ml | 1.0 | 4 g | 880 | 35 kcal |

The food footprints total **65% of the plate**. *Dressing overlaps the other foods rather than adding coverage.*

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **433 g and 970 kcal** is plausible for the visible pizza and fish with a modest amount of lentils and a few leaves. Fish species and pizza thickness are the largest uncertainties.
